initialization: sets local $70=$0004; clears local $76/$78/$7A; loads offsets through CODE_80:DEB9; writes through CODE_80:DF1D

loader.rows: uses base + local $76 and base + local $76 + $0020
loader.outputs: reads signed bytes into local $78/$7A, then conditionally two's-complement negates each according to two successive ASL operations on local $44

scheduler: each call decrements local $70; when it reaches zero, reloads $0004, increments local $76 modulo $0008, and reloads offsets

postprocess.gate: only when direct-page accumulator equals global $00A6
postprocess.per_axis: if local offset + $0018 is not below $0030, clear that offset

limitations: The rows and selector bits are preserved structurally; they are not named as an animation, camera, or football effect.
The local $44 condition bits are not assigned a flip/direction meaning.
The shared targets remain scratch state, not a permanent entity position.
